Properties.Octopus.Action.Script.ScriptBody:
$DirEnv = "WebArgosy_" + $OctopusParameters["Octopus.Environment.Name"]
$PathX = $DirEnv + "_" + $OctopusParameters["Octopus.Action[DetermineNextSide].Output.SideX"]
$Path = Join-Path $CustomInstallDir $PathX

$ConfigPath = $ConfigFile

# check params
if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($Path)) {
Write-Error "Path parameter is not set"
throw "Path parameter is not set"
}

if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($ConfigPath)) {
Write-Error "ConfigPath parameter is not set"
throw "ConfigPath parameter is not set"
}

Write-Host "CONFIG SETUP SCRIPT"

Write-Host "ROOT of APP = $Path"
Write-Host "CONFIG_PATH = $ConfigPath"
Write-Host ""

cd $Path

$BaseCustomDir = Split-Path $Path -Parent
$SubDir = Split-Path $Path -Leaf

Write-Host "BASE_DIR : $BaseCustomDir, SUBDIR: $SubDir"


if (!(Test-Path $Path)) {

	Write-Host "ROOT off SITE does not exist : $Path"
	exit 1
}


## CONFIG
$ConfigFullPath = Join-Path $BaseCustomDir $ConfigPath

Write-Host "USING CONFIG : $ConfigFullPath"
Write-Host "COPY $ConfigFullPath\*.* $Path"
Write-Host "-------------------"
#prebaci sve confige za WebArgosy
Copy-Item $ConfigFullPath\*.* $Path -Recurse -Force -container

#prebaci config za MIBIS ako je ovo MIBIS instalacija
if (Test-Path -Path $ConfigFullPath\APPMAN\) { 
	Write-Host "COPY $ConfigFullPath\APPMAN\*.* $Path\AppManager"
	Copy-Item $ConfigFullPath\APPMAN\*.* $Path\AppManager -Recurse -Force -container
    #uguraj config u zip za instalaciju
    Write-Host "UPDATE ZIP $Path\AppManager\AppsManager.zip with $Path\AppManager\localAppSettings.config"
    Compress-Archive -update $Path\AppManager\localAppSettings.config $Path\AppManager\AppsManager.zip
    }
    
if (Test-Path -Path $ConfigFullPath\ARGOSYNC\) {
	Write-Host "COPY $ConfigFullPath\ARGOSYNC\*.* $Path\App_Data"
	Copy-Item $ConfigFullPath\ARGOSYNC\*.* $Path\App_Data -Recurse -Force -container
    }

$DirEnv = "WebArgosy_" + $OctopusParameters["Octopus.Environment.Name"]
$PathX = $DirEnv + "_ARR"
$Path = Join-Path $CustomInstallDir $PathX
$PathVirtualFolder = Join-Path $Path $ArrVirtualPath

$ConfigPath = $ConfigFile

# check params
if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($Path)) {
Write-Error "Path parameter is not set"
throw "Path parameter is not set"
}

if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($ConfigPath)) {
Write-Error "ConfigPath parameter is not set"
throw "ConfigPath parameter is not set"
}

Write-Host "CONFIG SETUP SCRIPT"

Write-Host "ROOT of APP = $Path"
Write-Host "CONFIG_PATH = $ConfigPath"
Write-Host ""

cd $Path

$BaseCustomDir = Split-Path $Path -Parent
$SubDir = Split-Path $Path -Leaf

Write-Host "BASE_DIR : $BaseCustomDir, SUBDIR: $SubDir"


if (!(Test-Path $Path)) {

	Write-Host "ROOT off SITE does not exist : $Path"
	exit 1
}


## CONFIG
$ConfigFullPath = Join-Path $BaseCustomDir $ConfigPath

Write-Host "USING CONFIG : $ConfigFullPath"
Write-Host "COPY $ConfigFullPath\ARR\*.* $PathVirtualFolder"
Write-Host "-------------------"
#prebaci sve confige za WebArgosy
Copy-Item $ConfigFullPath\ARR\*.* $PathVirtualFolder -Recurse -Force -container

Properties.Octopus.Action.Script.ScriptBody:
# Load IIS module:
Import-Module WebAdministration

# Set a name of the site we want to start
$webSiteName = $OctopusParameters['webSiteName']

# Get web site object
try {
$webSite = Get-Item "IIS:\Sites\$webSiteName"
}
Catch [System.IO.FileNotFoundException]{
	# Some OS bug out if Default Web Site is deleted.
# So we need to call this 2 times.
$webSite = Get-Item "IIS:\Sites\$webSiteName"
}

Write-Output "Starting IIS web site $webSiteName"
$webSite.Start()

# Load IIS module:
Import-Module WebAdministration

# Get AppPool Name
$appPoolName = $OctopusParameters['appPoolName']

Write-Output "Starting IIS app pool $appPoolName"
Start-WebAppPool $appPoolName

Properties.Octopus.Action.Script.ScriptBody:
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop" #stop uzrokuje da se catch uopce poziva

try {

cd C:\windows\system32\inetsrv\

.\appcmd.exe set config -section:system.webServer/proxy -enabled:true
Write-Host "EXIT CODE:" $LASTEXITCODE
.\appcmd.exe set config  -section:system.webServer/proxy /timeout:"00:20:00"  /commit:apphost
Write-Host "EXIT CODE:" $LASTEXITCODE
.\appcmd.exe set config -section:system.webServer/proxy /includePortInXForwardedFor:"False" /commit:apphost
Write-Host "EXIT CODE:" $LASTEXITCODE

Exit 0

}
catch {
  Write-Warning $Error[0].Exception.GetType().FullName 
  Write-Warning $Error[0]
  Write-Host $_.ScriptStackTrace
  
  Exit 0
}
